header: THE OFFICIAL FIGURES OF THE STEEL CARD: everything here is copied from the Ministry of Steel's "Monthly Economic Report" (one PDF a month, https://steel.gov.in/monthly-summary) and its "An Overview of Steel Sector" (September 2026). I fetch nothing while the card is open: this is a reviewed file with its sources. Generated from the ten reports of December 2025 to September 2026 and checked:

* RETAIL: the month-end retail prices in Mumbai (Rs per tonne, GST included) that each report states in words (TMT 10 mm, HR coil 2.50 mm, CR coil 0.63 mm). The month-on-month changes the reports state agree with the figures for every month except July 2026 hot-rolled coil (the July report says -0.3%; its own figures, and the August report's +0.6%, give +1.2%: I keep the figure 68,990, and the slip is in the report's percentage).
* IRON_ORE: NMDC lump ore price (Rs per tonne) as the reports say it; the April 2026 report does not say it in words, so April is empty.

* CPSE: SAIL, RINL and NMDC Steel (NSL), in million tonnes (MT; the Ministry's table is in lakh tonnes and the script divides by 10), month by month: each report gives its month, the month before and the same month a year earlier. Where a month appears in two reports I keep the NEWER report's figure (it is the revised one); the differences are in the second decimal.
* WSA: crude steel production by country (million tonnes) from the World Steel Association's figures as the reports quote them (a month behind the report); I keep the newest report's figure.
* ANNUAL: the Joint Plant Committee's figures in the Overview and in Annexure I of the September 2026 report.
The reports are provisional ("P") and are revised: the card says so. Important: this file is written by scripts/steel/refresh-mos.py, so do not edit it by hand.
